Setting.TermsAndConditions_1:
50% of Registration fees will be refunded if cancellation received up to 31/01/2023.
No refunds will be made for registration cancellations received after 31/01/2023.
Cancellation should be sent in writing to the Organizing Committee.
Cancellation will not be considered unless it is received & confirmed by the Organizing Committee.
